question: Who was the Speaker of 16th Lok Sabha?
solution:
​The correct answer is __**Sumitra Mahajan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Sumitra Mahajan** was the Speaker of the 16th Lok Sabha.
 
• Sumitra Mahajan was born on 12 April 1943, is an Indian politician who was the **Speaker of Lok Sabha from 2014 to 2019.** She belongs to **Bharatiya Janata Party**.
